question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**worrying**" means causing anxiety or concern. (चिंताजनक)
 
• In the context of the passage, "a worrying shift" indicates a change towards something problematic, in this case, the increase in single-use plastic products.
 
• The other options: "**precious**" (valuable or important), "**earthy**" (related to natural, unrefined qualities), and "**gloomy**" (dark or pessimistic) do not fit the context as appropriately as "worrying".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** We are seeing other worrying trends. By the 1970s, the rate of plastic production has grown faster than that of any other material. If historic growth trends continue, global production of primary plastic is forecasted to reach 1,100 million tonnes by 2050. We have also seen a worrying__ shift towards single-use plastic products, items that are meant to be thrown away after a single short use.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Precious (अनमोल)**: Of great value or importance. 

 
 
• **Example:** She wore a precious necklace.
 
 
 
• **Earthy (मिट्टी जैसा)**: Refers to natural, unrefined qualities. 
 
 
• **Example:** The wine had an earthy flavor.
 
 
 
• **Gloomy (उदास)**: Dark or pessimistic in mood or appearance. 
 
 
• **Example:** The weather was gloomy.
